articles.title: Former PHV driver-turned-vending machine boss now broke; investors worry about their $4m
articles.content: SINGAPORE - He branded himself as a former private-hire vehicle (PHV) driver-turned-savvy businessman, with investments in 500-plus vending machines and commercial properties. Financial adviser Kevin Lin put in $484,300 from 2023, including $291,322 which he had secured through bank loans. The returns were initially prompt. Lin said they then slowed to a trickle, and eventually stopped. A flurry of complaints and police reports followed.
